Lemma
[Uniform time-derivative bounds for $\widetilde L_i$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0161, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0162 ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-a-l-distance-gradient-bound 1. ch30:30.8\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

On the same compact space-time sets as in Lemma 2, \[ \left|\frac{\partial \widetilde L_i}{\partial t}\right|\leq C \] uniformly for all sufficiently large $i$.
